name: agentmail
description: Connect AgentMail to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use AgentMail MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect AgentMail to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with email inboxes for agents using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my AgentMail workspace.
Find anything in AgentMail that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review email inboxes for agents in AgentMail.
